notes:
## Flex Mechs and general bug fixes

- Added the Plus-only Flex Mechs plugin with Horse Dash and Speed Flip, configurable 1–3 input keybinds, and separate mechanic settings.
- Restricted Flex Mechs to verified Training, LAN, and Private Match sessions; Casual, Ranked, Tournament, Workshop, and unknown sessions remain blocked.
- Renamed Name Spoofer to Name Changer while keeping existing saved settings compatible.
- Fixed Item Swapper deactivation and Platform Display activation.
- Improved Controller and KBM overlay designs, skin/press HEX colors, and input reliability.
- Fixed Alpha Boost custom colors and removed custom HEX car colors.
- Added Custom Shader to BondoMod Plus and improved real activation progress displays.
- Refined the Rank Changer icon and reduced the BondoMod Plus highlight.
